book.paradise.chart.value: This is an original voluntary parallel entry beside the supplied-MTL first-Goa era. You keep your actual living native body, owned cargo and learned history. Ordinary district work and optional contractor travel are separate choices. Entry supplies only the disclosed local language understanding, not Su Xiao’s Hunter role, talent, money, guard office, memories, private task or return protection. Unknown source rights remain unknown. All costs, local played intervals and alternative outcomes are original prototypes; unsupported absence freezes the place.

book.paradise.enrollment.value: Chose your own retained human character in a first-Goa alternate branch. Contractor service and language contact are this entry’s limited authored approval, not Su Xiao’s coerced Hunter trial. You own no copied office, talent, memories, equipment or another entrant’s settlement. Source-era cast keeps its own body, goods and private plans. Hub service institutions are evidenced after his Goa return; their concurrent placement here is an explicit original branch choice.

book.paradise.passage.book.paradise.ente.value: Arrived at your actual return point in the same controlled body and owned cargo. Source-world people, dead/departed states, stock, learned work and changed history remain. Unsupported absence freezes; no source-protagonist reward or reset followed.

book.paradise.hub.value: The service worker offers one packing shift funded by their own materials and eight owned credits, a two-credit bracing lesson and paid rest. You remain an independent visitor; service work grants no Hunter title.

book.paradise.packingReceipt.value: The service worker paid eight owned district credits for your completed packing shift and supplied the wood, rope and reusable kit. Those finite wages are yours; this grants no employee office or Hunter task.

book.paradise.campaign.entry.value: This optional continuation represents the sid20 first-Goa fire, gate and immediate retained aftermath, beside an original paid hub workshop. Its 58–72 local-minute rescue window is a game proposal, not the source tomorrow18:00/midnight notices. People keep their own body, money, materials, attention and source knowledge. Your learned line procedure is ordinary physical craft, not Hunter talent or mana. Failure can kill the endangered Hank; no source restoration, free loot, save rewind, prestige or universal evacuation follows. Previously reserved jobs retain their original terms.

book.paradise.campaign.bench.value: My two actual logs, rope, two stamina and five played minutes became one personally owned small bench. The original district permits this finite work surface. It supports personal kit repair and paid deliveries; it grants no room, employee office, World Source or automatic stock.

book.paradise.campaign.drying_rack.value: Built a three-stave rack at my paid district bench. It supplies ordinary air exchange, not dry material, outdoor weather or a magical field.

book.paradise.campaign.environment_suppl.value: Bought the supplier’s finite sealed crate: two clear, two cloudy and one brackish local wash portions. Original measured workshop stock; no rain or drinking-water claim.

book.paradise.campaign.environment_filte.value: Strained one exact water portion through one actual linen cloth. Suspended grit stayed with the spent filter; dissolved salt and contamination stayed in the water. No general purification or free cloth restoration occurred.

missed.shower.value: The shower passed; the craftsman dried his bench. No missed reward is owed.

book.paradise.campaign.environment_softe.value: One real log and a suitable measured water portion became two damp repair staves. Paid washing softened the preparation, saving one stamina against ordinary cutting. The exact water, timber and held kit remain in the preparation receipt. Dry the actual pieces before binding a usable kit.

book.paradise.private.eraPlan.value: My source-era goal is Philip Herbert; I hold the guard-chief appointment and my current sword. I remember the franchise imperfectly and do not know its exact present era. The king task deadline and agreed next-day fire time are distinct. I distrust the promised pirate reward; current mana and later outcomes are not guaranteed.

book.paradise.private.ownDuty.value: I hold my actual operation-duty copy and know the local guardhouse rules. I am wary of the new chief; no friendship or knowledge of his private Hunter target follows.

book.paradise.private.bargain.value: I possess the represented ignition casks and know the agreed local operation and promised reward. Other people may mislead me; my operation requires actual remaining fuel and means.
